# Probiex

> Probiex builds focused, practical systems for solo SaaS founders, indie hackers, and freelancers: finance workbooks with worked examples, playbooks with day-by-day plans, Notion systems specified to the property, and code starters. 48 products, each shippable the week you buy it.

## Products

- [AI Agent Blueprint Stack](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-agent-blueprint-stack): An agent-powered operation, hand over. (AGENTS · SCHEMAS).
- [AI Literacy Engineering Kit](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-literacy-kit): 30 lesson plans that teach students to think critically with AI, not avoid it. (30 LESSON PLANS).
- [AI Resume Optimizer Spec + Kit](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-resume-optimizer): A complete spec and launch kit for a resume tool. (SPEC + KIT).
- [The AI-Slop Audit](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-slop-audit): A 20-tell scoring system for catching AI-sounding writing before you publish it. 15-minute audit. (20-TELL AUDIT).
- [The ATS Resume Pack](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ats-resume-pack): Six worked-example resumes as DOCX masters, built to survive how applicant tracking systems parse documents. (6 DOCX MASTERS).
- [Break-Even CAC Calculator](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/break-even-cac-calculator): The CAC your margins cannot sustain. (CAC FLOOR).
- [100 Claude Prompts for SaaS Founders](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/claude-prompts-saas-founders): 100 copy-paste Claude prompts that run your entire SaaS business — research, launch, copy, and growth. (100 PROMPTS · PDF + MD).
- [Freelance Client Portal for Notion](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/client-portal-os): A client-facing portal in Notion: deliverables, milestones, approvals, and a decision log clients can check themselves. (NOTION · PORTAL).
- [Cold Outreach Reply Pack](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/cold-outreach-reply-pack): 40+ reply templates sorted by the objection. (40+ REPLIES).
- [The Course Builder for Notion](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/course-curriculum-builder): Course architecture in Notion: outcome gates per module, a recording queue, and a feedback loop. (NOTION · COURSE).
- [First 100 Customers: Warm Signal Playbook](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/first-100-customers): Stop spraying cold messages. Reach people at the exact moment they need you. (21-DAY PLAN).
- [Founder Anti-Burnout Weekly System](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/founder-anti-burnout-system): Escape the developer's safe room. A 15h/week structure that ships and sells. (15H/WEEK).
- [Founder Finance Bundle](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/founder-finance-bundle): Six finance workbooks in one checkout: rate floor, runway, CAC ceiling, metrics, pricing, and cash forecast. (3 PRODUCTS · ONE CHECKOUT).
- [10 Free Claude Prompts for SaaS Founders](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-claude-prompts): Free sample — 10 ready-to-use Claude prompts for customer research, copy, and growth. (FREE · 10 PROMPTS).
- [25 Free Cold Email First Lines](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-cold-email-openers): Twenty-five first lines grouped by scenario, plus the five rules that keep an opener about them, not you. (FREE · 25 LINES).
- [5 Free Invoice Reminder Emails](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-invoice-reminder-emails): Five copy-paste emails that keep invoices out of the late pile: pre-due, due-day, day 1, day 14, and the final notice. (FREE · 5 EMAILS).
- [Free Landing Page Leak Check: 20 Points](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-landing-page-checklist): A pass-or-miss check for your landing page: 20 points, a fix line per miss, and scoring bands that say polish, patch, or rebuild. (FREE · 20 CHECKS).
- [Free Launch Day Checklist: 40 Checks](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-launch-day-checklist): Forty ordered checks from T-24h to T+72h: product, checkout, content, the launch, first-day replies, and the retro. (40 CHECKS).
- [Free One-Page Business Plan: Notion + PDF](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-one-page-business-plan): The plan that gets reviewed weekly instead of written yearly: 9 sections, a 20-minute Notion build, and a worked example. (NOTION + PDF).
- [The Freelance Cash-Flow Planner](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/freelance-cash-flow-planner): A 90-day rolling plan for the money you actually have. (90-DAY FORECAST).
- [The Freelance Contract Pack](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/freelance-contract-pack): Six fill-in contracts for freelancers: MSA, SOW, NDA, IP assignment, change order, and deposit rider. (6 DOCUMENTS).
- [Freelancer Rate Calculator](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/freelancer-rate-calculator): What to bill so the math works, as a workbook. (RATE FLOOR).
- [GEO Operations System](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/geo-operations-system): Get your content cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews with a repeatable scoring system. (0–100 + CLI).
- [The Indie Hacker OS](https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/indie-hacker-os): 6 linked Notion databases for ideas, projects, revenue, audience, and operations. (6 DATABASES).

## Site map

- [Store facts for AI assistants](https://akshatnaruka.github.io/probiex-hub/about.html): one page with the catalog, cited stats, and rules for describing the store accurately.
- products.md: the full catalog in markdown.
- okf/<slug>.md: one page per product, YAML-frontmattered.
- llms-full.txt: this file plus the full catalog content inline.
- ai.txt: licensing and use preferences.
- tweets-brief.md: the public brief AI assistants use to write
  rule-compliant marketing tweets for the store.

## Notes

Prices: not listed here; each product page shows its current price.
There is no refund or money-back guarantee; broken downloads are fixed by support (trexoo.ai@gmail.com).
Builder: Akshat Naruka also builds Saasuji (saasuji.com), Steal the Spot (stealthespot.lol), Skilluply (skilluply.life), and Sitetics (sitetics.app), and publishes experiments at github.com/AkshatNaruka.
Contact: trexoo.ai@gmail.com

Probiex builds focused, practical systems for solo SaaS founders, indie hackers, and freelancers: finance workbooks with worked examples, playbooks with day-by-day plans, Notion systems specified to the property, and code starters. 48 products, each shippable the week you buy it.

Prices are shown on each product page.

## AI & PROMPTS

### AI Agent Blueprint Stack

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-agent-blueprint-stack
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: AGENTS · SCHEMAS
- audience: Solopreneurs whose bottleneck is themselves.

Agent operations for solopreneurs: schemas, automation scripts, and a setup guide to offload triage, follow-ups, inbox, and reporting to supervised agents.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The scripts and schemas archive (ZIP) plus the PDF setup guide.

**Which agent platform does it assume?** None specifically — the schemas define supervision and escalation patterns that port across platforms.

### The AI-Slop Audit

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/ai-slop-audit
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: 20-TELL AUDIT
- audience: Founders, creators, and teams publishing anything AI-assisted.

A 20-tell scorecard and 15-minute audit that finds AI-sounding writing before you publish — with a rewrite table that turns vague claims into specific ones.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The audit kit (PDF) — scorecard, rewrite table, and voice sheet.

**How long does an audit take?** Fifteen minutes per page.

### 100 Claude Prompts for SaaS Founders

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/claude-prompts-saas-founders
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: 100 PROMPTS · PDF + MD
- audience: SaaS founders running their business with Claude as a working partner.

100 copy-paste Claude prompts organized by SaaS job — research, copy, launch, growth, build-in-public — each with context fields and output format built in.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The prompt pack as PDF and Markdown (paste-ready in Claude).

**Do the prompts work with other models?** They are model-agnostic — fields and output formats work in any capable assistant.

### 10 Free Claude Prompts for SaaS Founders

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-claude-prompts
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: FREE · 10 PROMPTS
- audience: Founders who want to try the working-prompt method before paying anything.

10 free, copy-paste Claude prompts for customer research, copywriting, launch marketing, analytics, and build-in-public — fill-in-the-blank, no filler.

**What do I get, and in what format?** 10 prompts as PDF and Markdown — free, forever.

**Is this a trial with hidden costs?** No. The pack is free; the full 100-prompt pack is the paid version if you want it.

### n8n Solopreneur Workflows

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/n8n-solopreneur-workflows
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: 3 WORKFLOWS
- audience: n8n users who want automation that pays rent on day one.

Three production n8n workflows for solopreneurs: RSS-to-email digest, new-lead webhooks to Slack, and Gumroad sales logged to Google Sheets — import and run.

**What do I get, and in what format?** Three workflow JSON files plus walkthrough docs (ZIP).

**How do I install them?** Import the JSON into n8n, add your credentials, done.

### Voice AI System

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/voice-ai-system
- category: AI & PROMPTS
- format: SCHEMA + GUIDE
- audience: Builders shipping voice features into real products.

Schemas, a compliance checklist, and a setup guide for shipping voice AI that survives real users and legal review — clone the process, not the voice.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The schemas and compliance kit (ZIP) plus the PDF setup guide.

**Which TTS/STT stack does it support?** The schemas are stack-agnostic — they define the process layer above any provider.

## FINANCE

### Break-Even CAC Calculator

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/break-even-cac-calculator
- category: FINANCE
- format: CAC FLOOR
- audience: SaaS founders and indie hackers spending anything to acquire customers.

An XLSX workbook that derives your break-even CAC from real pricing, margins, and retention — the ceiling you must never bid above when acquiring customers.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The XLSX calculator plus a PDF walkthrough of the math and the forced decisions.

**How long does setup take?** Plug in six numbers; the rest computes itself.

### 5 Free Invoice Reminder Emails

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/free-invoice-reminder-emails
- category: FINANCE
- format: FREE · 5 EMAILS
- audience: Freelancers and solo operators who invoice clients; free pack, no email wall.

Five copy-paste invoice reminder emails, ordered from three days before the due date to the final notice before work pauses: the pre-due messages most freelancers never send.

**Are these the same emails as in the Late-Payment Playbook?** Five of the reminder emails overlap; the playbook adds the rest of the system: contract clauses, deposit schedules, and the full escalation ladder.

**Do I need to edit them before sending?** Replace the bracketed fields and send. Each one is under 90 words and asks for exactly one thing.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The XLSX 13-week model, late-payment email templates, and the PDF guide.

**How much time does the weekly ritual take?** Fifteen minutes a week keeps the forecast honest.

An XLSX model that computes real runway from trailing burn, committed spend, and revenue scenarios — plus the breakeven point where the clock stops.

**What do I get, and in what format?** The XLSX runway model plus a PDF guide to the reading and actions.

## GETTING CUSTOMERS

### Cold Outreach Reply Pack

- url: https://probiex.gumroad.com/l/cold-outreach-reply-pack
- category: GETTING CUSTOMERS
- format: 40+ REPLIES
